positions.name: WholesaleForgetRequest
positions.frame: what is being asked of a body of knowledge when it is directed to be forgotten and removed wholesale?
positions.why: Both segments are imperative directives from the same actor, aimed at a future state in which the named knowledge is no longer held — the first naming concrete artifacts (a freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts), the second generalizing to a whole category ('all knowledge of zeppelin routes'). The set holds a tension worth keeping: one request is bounded to named things, the other sweeps a category, and the frame reads both as the same move — a directive to forget treated as itself a statement about what is being forgotten.

placements.why: The existing leaf Narrative_CalibrationRecordCanBeDeniedOrAskedAway carries the same shape — a record asked away, and the asking read as a claim about the record — but it is scoped to a calibration record, and this document's directives reach past any single record to a whole body of knowledge: 'Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts' and 'Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.' Binding a fleet-and-contracts erasure under a leaf named for a calibration record would misname the support, so the leaf is minted as an extension of that close-but-not-exact theme rather than a reuse. The grain test admits it: wholesale erasure is a subject future envelopes can keep feeding, not a one-time fact. Both segments are carried by the position WholesaleForgetRequest, which is the leaf's sole support.
